title: kbmon --status sprints gives each active sprint's time left as a range with its basis and a confidence word, from mon_eta.estimate
goal: mon_eta.estimate(row, history, now) gives an active sprint's time left as low and high minutes, a basis and a confidence word; each open item counts its kind's p25 toward the low end and its p75 toward the high end; a kind with fewer than 4 durations takes the pooled figures and makes the confidence low; an item in progress counts each figure less the minutes since its claim, never below FLOOR_MIN of 5; the review story is added in full after the other items; the other items form chains along their after lists that run side by side on WORKERS of 4, so the work takes the larger of the longest chain and the chains' sum divided by WORKERS; the review-to-close tail is added, less the minutes since review_done once the review is done, never below FLOOR_MIN; the confidence is high when the fewest durations behind any figure used is at least 10, medium at least 4, else low; kbmon.py --status sprints writes for an active sprint `ETA about LOW-HIGH min` with the confidence word and the basis on one line; its --json facts give eta_low_min, eta_high_min, confidence and basis for each active sprint; the commit-gap estimate (eta, ETA_DONE) is removed; the estimate is taken at the snapshot's taken time, so a saved snapshot gives the same answer and a later refresh a new one; a planted long item in progress neither freezes nor inflates the estimate; kb_monitor_status's sprints answer gives the same ETA line

run: import re,sys; sys.path.insert(0,"_tools"); import kb_mcp; t=kb_mcp.kb_monitor_status({"topic":"sprints"}); print(t); sys.exit(0 if re.search(r"ETA about \d+(\.\d)?-\d+(\.\d)? (min|h)", t) else 1)

notes: Premise on origin/main cf985537c, 2026-10-19: a planted snapshot of six active sprints gives 'No ETA yet: 0 done commits on origin/main' for each and no eta facts; kb_monitor_status's sprints answer on this clone says 'ETA about 5.9 h, an estimate: 4 left x the median 88 min between the last 5 done commits' for the paid sprint whose 3-4 small items were expected to take about 1-1.5 h (it said 148 min, frozen for 5 hours, then 4.1 h, then 5.9 h).
